description: A Google Doc as markdown (headings, lists, tables, bold/italic/links), with an index of its sections: each heading's stable id and path ("Plan > Risks"). Pass `section` (an id, a path or a unique title) to read one section. Returns revisionId for a later edit's expected_revision. Reads the first tab unless `tab` names another; images, footnotes and the like are left out, and `notShown` counts them.

account.description: Which account: a label from list_accounts (its editors section). Empty means the default account.

document_id.description: The document's id, or its URL.

section.description: A section id, path or unique heading title. Empty reads the whole document.

tab.description: A tab other than the first: its id (t.abc) or title, from get_document. Empty means the first tab.

name: read_document
title: Read a Google Doc
